item.title: 'Huna' writer wins National Book Award for non-fiction, after not being allowed into the U.S.
item.description: Abdelrahman ElGendy published a recent essay about being denied a visa to enter the U.S. for the ceremony. His book is a memoir about his time as a political prisoner in Egypt.

item.title: Anthropic IPO raises record $81.3 billion on strong AI demand
item.description: The five-year-old artificial intelligence powerhouse priced its initial public offering at $83 a share, shrugging off growing concern about a possible AI bubble and volatility in tech stocks.

item.title: After Nepal's epic flood, they're restoring their community ... and their lives
item.description: As the emergency response to the flood ends, aid workers turn to the hard work of rebuilding communities that lost everything. Many of those workers lost everything, too.

item.title: Trump, Xi and Putin set to meet in historic summit
item.description: On the sidelines of a high-powered regional economic forum in China, Presidents Trump, Xi and Putin sit down for an unprecedented meeting with nuclear non-proliferation expected to be a focus.

item.title: Democratic strategists think Montana House race could hold the secret to future wins
item.description: Montana is sending a Democrat to the U.S. House for the first time in three decades. Many in the party think Sam Forstag's campaign may be a playbook for how Democrats can win again in rural America.

item.title: As overdose deaths fall, White House makes misleading claims about who deserves credit
item.description: In a statement celebrating the historic drop in drug deaths, the White House pointed to successes since President Trump took office. In fact, the biggest progress happened under the Biden administration.

item.description: On NPR's Morning Edition, fashion designer Karl Kani talks about his new memoir, dressing some of hip-hop's biggest stars and why skinny jeans aren't for everyone.

item.title: 'I Play Rocky' and 'Elsinore' can't land their punches, even with star performances
item.description: Two films harken back to previous Oscar-winning movies. Elsinore, set in 1989 London, centers on Ian Charleson, co-star of Chariots of Fire. I Play Rocky tells the origin story of Sly Stallone's hit.
